row.notes: Per-step (vt_Car_Dynamics table ref 0x145bff4f0) ERS energy integration plus wheel publish. ERS part (the CarErs object, param+0xa4c = substep count): integrates harvest power MGU-K/MGU-H and deploy into the energy store +0x19f0 (clamped by the +0x1080 spline), accumulates the lap counters +0x19c8..+0x19d8 (skipped when CarLive.flags bit 1 is set), writes the per-second channels +0x1a00 +0x1a04 +0x1a14 +0x1a18 +0x1a1c, and steps the value +0x1a28 (clamped +-5000). Wheel part: copies the solver per-wheel arrays into the wheel objects (SuspensionSystem +0x60 + i*8): +0x3b4 slip ratio <- +0x760, +0x3c4 longitudinal force <- +0x7e0 and ~15 more fields (+0x3a4, +0x3ac, +0x3bc, +0x3cc). Renamed from Car_Suspension_PublishWheelState (mislabelled; osd-vc name check V8816, re-read by car-re 2026-11-11)
